about_the_game:
Welcome to the stage of Forgetmenots, a story-driven puzzle adventure where memories linger like echoes in an empty theater. In this beautifully crafted world, the entire game plays out like a theatrical performance, with shifting stage floors revealing new scenes as you progress through a sidescrolling journey of wonder, mystery, and melancholy.

With a vibrant, whimsical aesthetic that contrasts its deeper themes, Forgetmenots tells a heartfelt story about loss and the fleeting nature of memories. Solve creative puzzles that bring the stage to life, uncover hidden moments from the past, and navigate a world where joy and sorrow dance together under the spotlight.

Game Features

  • 3D side-scrolling theatre

  • Interact with the world in many different ways. Pick up and throw or push large objects in order to restore the memory to its correct state.

  • Physics-based puzzles and interactions create challenging environments.

  • Explore this thrilling stylized theater 

Forgetmenots is a group project made by students. Expect a short yet thought-provoking game.
